Frequently asked questions

Do you offer emergency call-outs?
Yes. We answer emergency calls around the clock, every day of the year.
Which areas do you cover?
We cover Riverton and towns within about 25 miles across the Alder Valley.
Are your plumbers licensed and insured?
Yes. Every Brightside plumber is licensed and fully insured.
Can you give me a price over the phone?
We prefer to see the job first, so any estimate we give you is accurate.
Do you install tankless water heaters?
Yes. We install and service both tank and tankless water heaters.
How do I book a visit?
Use the booking link on our contact page, or call the office during opening hours.
Do you guarantee your work?
Yes. All of our workmanship is guaranteed for one year.
Do you work on weekends?
Yes. We book regular visits on Saturdays and handle emergencies on Sundays.
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept cards, checks and bank transfers.
